perspective:

- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn than usual and less vibrant than he remembered, so he asked if she was okay.
- Patricia told him it was “nothing really,” just personal stuff, and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk, and she said she appreciated that.
- He later overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He brought up financial planning and offered to discuss budgeting tips with her. Patricia said she had been overwhelmed with bills and would take him up on the offer soon.
- He then worried he might have overstepped, so he told Patricia he hadn’t meant to pry and only wanted to help. She reassured him that she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for the offer.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend, and she said she appreciated having someone to turn to.
- After that, he checked in casually by asking about her weekend. Patricia said she was fine and planned a quiet weekend at home, then asked about his plans.
- He said he would probably read and relax, and reminded her that she could reach out if she needed anything or wanted to chat. Patricia thanked him and said she’d keep it in mind.
- He continued checking in with her at work, offering help even just for coffee. Patricia said she was busy but handling things, thanked him for checking in, and said it was great to have his support. He responded that they were all there to help each other.
final_response:
From Jose’s perspective, he changed course because he worried he had overstepped by bringing up her finances and didn’t want her to feel he was prying.
